title: Backend API — GET + PATCH /api/admin/users/[id]
content:
Create API routes for editing individual user profiles.

## GET /api/admin/users/[id]
Return full user profile including fields not returned by the list endpoint:
- Returns: { id, nameZh, nameEn, email, phone, iaLicense, idDocNumber, idDocType, organization, isMember, memberId, role, createdAt }
- 404 if user not found
- ADMIN role guard

## PATCH /api/admin/users/[id]
Update user profile with strict field allowlist.

### Allowed fields (partial update supported):
- nameZh, nameEn, email, phone, iaLicense, idDocNumber, idDocType, organization, isMember, memberId

### Fields to reject (return 400):
- role (cannot change user role from STUDENT)
- passwordHash (never expose)
- Any registrant/payment-related fields (paymentStatus, receiptNumber, receiptPdfData, etc.)

### Validation:
- Email: regex validation
- Phone: format validation
- nameZh/nameEn: required (if provided, must be non-empty)
- idDocType: must be one of HKID/PASSPORT/PERMIT/OTHER if provided

### Response:
- Returns updated user object
- 404 if user not found
- 400 on validation failure or rejected fields

ADMIN role guard on both routes.

comments.text: Server-side field allowlist is critical. Must explicitly reject role, passwordHash, and all registrant/payment fields regardless of what the client sends.
